lines.cap: Cows chasing you in a field? Let go of your dog.
lines.say: Cows chasing you in a field? Let go of your dog.

lines.cap: A country walk. A field. Some cows with calves. And you, with your dog on a lead.
lines.say: A country walk. A field. Some cows with calves. And you, with your dog on a lead.

lines.cap: To a mother cow, your dog looks like a wolf. She'll protect her calf.
lines.say: To a mother cow, your dog looks like a wolf. She'll protect her calf.

lines.cap: Cows weigh over half a tonne, and can run faster than you.
lines.say: Cows weigh over half a tonne, and can run faster than you.

lines.cap: If they charge, let go of the lead. Your dog can outrun them, and will usually come back to you later.
lines.say: If they charge, let go of the lead. Your dog can outrun them, and will usually come back to you later.

lines.cap: Then keep calm. Walk away steadily, don't run. Head for the nearest exit, or the edge of the field.
lines.say: Then keep calm. Walk away steadily, don't run. Head for the nearest exit, or the edge of the field.

lines.cap: Better still, don't walk between cows and their calves. Go around.
lines.say: Better still, don't walk between cows and their calves. Go around.

lines.cap: Save this. Then share it with someone who walks their dog in the countryside.
lines.say: Save this. Then share it with someone who walks their dog in the countryside.
